recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-23732 unless OO opens a new issue to refine the wording.
issue_request: FHIR-23732 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to clarify that repeated DocumentReference.content entries are not separate documents/pages, but represent the same document in different formats, or attachment metadata, and to add guidance that related DocumentReference resources with a transforms relationship can represent the same document in multiple formats.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by PR #716 and commit 24ebc2aade, which updated the historical documentreference-spreadsheet.xml definition and added the .relatesTo transforms note. Commit 33b409a4b6 later migrated that source content into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread explains the ambiguity around separate scanned pages and confirms the intended model: content repetitions are alternative renderings/metadata for the same document, while separate pages or transforms use multiple DocumentReference resources linked with relatesTo. Existing combined-branch decisions for FHIR-25205 and FHIR-17909 touch nearby guidance and preserve the same interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml already contains the approved definition, a no-different-versions comment, and the requirements note about related DocumentReference transforms.

related_jiras.note: A later published audit concerned the same DocumentReference.content distinction and confirms current source says repeated content is not for different document versions.
A later source-changing reconciliation touched the same DocumentReference.content comment for title guidance while preserving the FHIR-23732 clarification.
